title: Facturae 3.2.2: the Spanish state's e-invoice file
source: Facturae 3.2.2, Facturaev3_2_2.xml as facturae.gob.es publishes it (SHA-256 b4bbcd587f5f). Invoices to Spanish public bodies are structured and carry an advanced electronic signature (Ley 25/2013 art. 5; disposición adicional segunda: Facturae and XAdES); certain suppliers must send them through the general entry point (art. 4). The library writes the file without a signature and says so: the schema accepts an unsigned file, no entry point does. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The Facturae 3.2.2 schema accepts the Spanish invoice or rectifying invoice beside the page; skipped when it is not installed. The file is unsigned, and the rule's evidence says so.
